# book_action_link (Resource)

The action_link records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `from_id` (String) The key of the action_node record.
- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `type` (String) The nimflow link type

### Optional

- `action_id` (String) The key of the action record.
- `name` (String) Name the target reads the value under
- `to_id` (String) The key of the action_node record.
- `value_path` (String) JSON path from $. of the value taken
- `value_type` (String) Value type passed
